items.headline: DOE approves cost-shared funding for Southern-led 150 kWt molten chloride test reactor
items.what_happened: Southern Company and Core Power announced that the Department of Energy approved cost-shared funding for the Molten Chloride Reactor Experiment (MCRE). It is a 150 kWt fast-spectrum test reactor at Idaho National Laboratory's Zero Power Physics Reactor cell. The approval funds an accelerated final development stage, and criticality could come as early as 2027.
items.why_it_matters: MCRE is a test rig, not a product a buyer can order, so it does not add a 1-20 MW offering. It does show DOE money moving to a fast-spectrum salt design, which matters if a microreactor developer later licenses that fuel and coolant chemistry.
items.binding_note: Announcement of DOE approval for cost-shared funding. The funding agreement text was not retrieved, so no executed award is confirmed here.
